theorem Shellsort.ExceptionalGapLower.exceptional_suffix :
  forall {n d H : Nat} (p : Shellsort.RankPlacement n) (u v : Shellsort.HarvestBlockIteration.PositiveWord),
  (forall (k : Subtype (fun (k : Nat) => LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) k)),
    Membership.mem u k → Dvd.dvd d (Subtype.val k)) →
  (forall (k : Subtype (fun (k : Nat) => LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) k)), Membership.mem v k → LE.le (Subtype.val k) H) →
  Eq (List.getLast? (List.map Subtype.val v)) (Option.some (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → LE.le
    (Shellsort.footrule (Shellsort.gapSort p d))
    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (Nat.cast H))
      (Nat.cast (Shellsort.ordinaryWordShifts (Shellsort.sortWord p (List.map Subtype.val u)) v))) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.ExceptionalGapLower.uniform_exception :
  forall {n d H : Nat} (hd : LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 2) d) (fits : LE.le d n)
    (u v : Shellsort.HarvestBlockIteration.PositiveWord),
  (forall (k : Subtype (fun (k : Nat) => LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) k)),
    Membership.mem u k → Dvd.dvd d (Subtype.val k)) →
  (forall (g : Subtype (fun (k : Nat) => LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) k)), Membership.mem v g → LE.le (Subtype.val g) H) →
  Eq (List.getLast? (List.map Subtype.val v)) (Option.some (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → (let price : Real :=
    HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (Nat.cast n) (Real.sqrt (HMul.hMul (Nat.cast n) (Nat.cast d)))) (OfNat.ofNat 1024);
  And
    (LE.le price
      (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (Nat.cast H))
        (Shellsort.uniformAverage
          (fun (p : Shellsort.RankPlacement n) => Nat.cast (Shellsort.ordinaryWordShifts p (HAppend.hAppend u v))))))
    (LE.le price
      (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (Nat.cast H))
        (Shellsort.uniformAverage
          (fun (p : Shellsort.RankPlacement n) =>
          Nat.cast (Shellsort.ordinaryWordComparisons p (HAppend.hAppend u v))))))) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.ExceptionalGapLower.two_sorted_identity :
  forall {n : Nat} (p : Shellsort.RankPlacement n),
  Eq (Shellsort.footrule (Shellsort.gapSort p (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
    (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2)
      (Nat.cast (Shellsort.gapInversions (Shellsort.gapSort p (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)))) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.ExceptionalGapLower.parity_shift_price :
  forall {n H : Nat} (p : Shellsort.RankPlacement n) (u v : Shellsort.HarvestBlockIteration.PositiveWord),
  (forall (k : Subtype (fun (k : Nat) => LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) k)),
    Membership.mem u k → Dvd.dvd (OfNat.ofNat 2) (Subtype.val k)) →
  (forall (k : Subtype (fun (k : Nat) => LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) k)), Membership.mem v k → LE.le (Subtype.val k) H) →
  Eq (List.getLast? (List.map Subtype.val v)) (Option.some (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → LE.le
    (Nat.cast (Shellsort.gapInversions (Shellsort.gapSort p (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
    (HMul.hMul (Nat.cast H)
      (Nat.cast (Shellsort.ordinaryWordShifts (Shellsort.sortWord p (List.map Subtype.val u)) v))) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.ExceptionalGapLower.legal_exception :
  forall {n d H : Nat},
  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 2) d → LE.le d n → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) H → (forall (w :
      Shellsort.HarvestBlockIteration.PositiveWord),
  Shellsort.PredeterminedOptimum.Legal n w → (forall (g : Subtype (fun (k : Nat) => LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) k)),
    Membership.mem w g → LT.lt H (Subtype.val g) → Dvd.dvd d (Subtype.val g)) →
  (let price : Real :=
    HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (Nat.cast n) (Real.sqrt (HMul.hMul (Nat.cast n) (Nat.cast d)))) (OfNat.ofNat 1024);
  And
    (LE.le price
      (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (Nat.cast H))
        (Shellsort.uniformAverage
          (fun (p : Shellsort.RankPlacement n) => Nat.cast (Shellsort.ordinaryWordShifts p w)))))
    (LE.le price
      (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (Nat.cast H))
        (Shellsort.uniformAverage
          (fun (p : Shellsort.RankPlacement n) => Nat.cast (Shellsort.ordinaryWordComparisons p w))))))) :=
  _

axiom propext {a b : Sort 0} : Iff a b → Eq a b

axiom Quot.sound.{u} {α : Sort u} {r : α → α → Sort 0} {a b : α} : r a b → Eq (Quot.mk r a) (Quot.mk r b)

axiom Classical.choice.{u} {α : Sort u} : Nonempty α → α
